paragraphs: Happy Painting by Sam is a residential and commercial painting company based in Windsor, Ontario. Sam runs every job personally. He's the one who comes out to look at your space, gives you an honest quote and makes sure the final coat is right, with clear communication the whole way through.
That's the idea behind the name: the job isn't finished until you're happy with it.

promise.title: The little things are the whole thing.

tiles.title: Sharp lines. Guaranteed.
tiles.text: Crisp edges where walls meet trim and ceilings. It's the detail everyone notices.

tiles.title: Most rooms in a day.
tiles.text: Typical residential rooms are finished in a single day, so your life isn't on hold.

tiles.title: On time, on schedule.
tiles.text: Shows up when promised and finishes when promised. Simple as that.

tiles.title: Your stuff, protected.
tiles.text: Floors and furniture covered with drop cloths before a single can is opened.

tiles.title: Full clean-up.
tiles.text: Tape, cloths and mess, gone. You get your room back, just better.

tiles.title: Not done till you're happy.
tiles.text: Sam doesn't call a job finished until you do. It's in the name.

faq.a: Yes. Sam comes out, looks at the project in person and gives you an honest quote at no cost and with no obligation.

faq.q: How long does a typical room take?
faq.a: Most residential rooms are finished in a single day. For bigger jobs, ask Sam for a timeline when he quotes.

faq.q: Will my floors and furniture be protected?
faq.a: Yes. Floors and furniture are covered with drop cloths and edges are taped before painting starts, and everything is cleaned up before Sam leaves.
Windsor, Tecumseh, LaSalle, Lakeshore, Essex, Amherstburg, Belle River and Kingsville. Somewhere else in the county? Ask anyway.

faq.q: Do you paint exteriors and commercial spaces?
faq.a: Yes. Exteriors include siding, stucco, brick, trim, soffits, doors, decks, fences, porches and garages. Commercial work includes offices, retail, rental turnovers and real-estate refreshes.

faq.q: What if I'm not happy with the result?
faq.a: Then the job isn't done. Sam doesn't consider a job finished until you're happy with it. It's in the name.
